hero.heading: Let's talk
hero.subheading: Discovery calls are 30 minutes. Whether you have a finished AI system, a pilot in progress, or a question on a leadership agenda, I'll look at where you are and tell you honestly what would help.
intro.heading: What happens in a discovery call
intro.body: We spend 30 minutes looking at your situation together: a live system, an innovation project, a team that needs to get up to speed, or an organisation working out what responsible AI adoption even means for them. You leave with a clear sense of where the gaps are and whether working together makes sense. There is no pitch, no obligation, and no invoice.
email.heading: Send a message
email.body: The best way to reach me is by email. I aim to respond within two working days.
linkedin.heading: Connect on LinkedIn
linkedin.body: I write about EU AI Act implementation, accessible AI design, and responsible AI adoption. Follow along or send a message there.
